clause: Auto-layout spacing: wrap, gap (numeric/auto/negative), canvas-stacking, padding [STU-DS-037,STU-DS-038,STU-DS-039,STU-DS-040]

scope.summary: Implement auto-layout spacing on StudioAutoLayout: horizontal wrap (overflowing children flow to the next line for responsive multi-row layouts); gap accepting a numeric value, an auto value (space-between distribution), and negative values (overlapping stacks) while preserving flow order; a canvas-stacking setting controlling first-on-top vs last-on-top render for overlapping children; and padding settable uniformly, per axis, or per individual side. Solving is in the LayoutEngine.
acceptance_criteria: auto-layout wrap + numeric/auto/negative gap + canvas-stacking + uniform/per-axis/per-side padding
expected_tests: test: wrap flows to next line; gap numeric/auto/negative preserving order; canvas-stacking first/last-on-top; padding uniform/per-axis/per-side

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Auto-layout spacing incomplete; wrap, negative gaps, stacking, per-side padding missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
